title: GitHub Actions | Usage & Reliability
description: Deduplicated completed workflow attempts, success rates, observed job execution time, and queue waits.

options.content:
**Daily UTC trends.** All panels follow the global time picker; default: **90 days**. Auto-refresh is off to limit Athena scans. Use the dashboard links above to switch sections while preserving the time range.

**No data is not zero usage.** Only recorded dates are shown; lines may connect sparse observations. Missing source values are not replaced with zero.

Webhook silver refreshes hourly. Workflow retries count as separate attempts; job snapshots are deduplicated by job ID. Execution minutes are observed wall time, **not billed minutes**. Queue wait includes scheduling/dependency delays and is measured only for completed jobs, not jobs still waiting.

panels.title: Completed workflow attempts by conclusion
panels.description: One completed snapshot per workflow_run_id/run_attempt. Retries are separate attempts. Completion day uses updated_at from the completed payload. Missing run_attempt is treated as the initial attempt.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT updated_at, conclusion,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY workflow_run_id, coalesce(run_attempt, 1)
      ORDER BY updated_at DESC, received_at DESC, delivery_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM github_webhooks_silver_dev.actions_workflow_runs
  WHERE event_type = 'workflow_run' AND action = 'completed' AND status = 'completed'
    AND $__timeFilter(updated_at)
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', updated_at) AS time,
  coalesce(conclusion, 'unknown') AS conclusion, count(*) AS attempts
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC, 2

panels.title: Workflow attempt success rate
panels.description: Successful / all completed workflow attempts. Cancelled, skipped, neutral, failed, and unknown conclusions remain in the denominator. Retries count separately. No completed attempts means no rate, not 0%.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT updated_at, conclusion,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY workflow_run_id, coalesce(run_attempt, 1)
      ORDER BY updated_at DESC, received_at DESC, delivery_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM github_webhooks_silver_dev.actions_workflow_runs
  WHERE event_type = 'workflow_run' AND action = 'completed' AND status = 'completed'
    AND $__timeFilter(updated_at)
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', updated_at) AS time,
  100.0 * count_if(conclusion = 'success') / count(*) AS success_rate
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Actions job execution minutes | observed, not billed
panels.description: Sum of started_at-to-completed_at job wall time, grouped by completion day. Deduplicated by workflow_job_id; rerun jobs with different IDs remain distinct. Includes hosted and self-hosted jobs, without billing rounding or runner multipliers.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT started_at, completed_at,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY workflow_job_id
      ORDER BY completed_at DESC, received_at DESC, delivery_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM github_webhooks_silver_dev.actions_workflow_jobs
  WHERE event_type = 'workflow_job' AND action = 'completed' AND status = 'completed'
    AND $__timeFilter(completed_at)
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', completed_at) AS time,
  sum(date_diff('second', started_at, completed_at)) / 60.0 AS execution_minutes
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1 AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at >= started_at
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Actions job duration | median & p95
panels.description: Completed jobs with valid non-negative started_at-to-completed_at durations, deduplicated by job ID and grouped by completion day. Excludes jobs that never started.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT started_at, completed_at,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY workflow_job_id
      ORDER BY completed_at DESC, received_at DESC, delivery_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM github_webhooks_silver_dev.actions_workflow_jobs
  WHERE event_type = 'workflow_job' AND action = 'completed' AND status = 'completed'
    AND $__timeFilter(completed_at)
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', completed_at) AS time,
  approx_percentile(date_diff('second', started_at, completed_at) / 60.0, 0.5) AS median_minutes,
  approx_percentile(date_diff('second', started_at, completed_at) / 60.0, 0.95) AS p95_minutes
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1 AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at >= started_at
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC

panels.title: Actions job queue wait | median & p95
panels.description: created_at-to-started_at elapsed time for completed jobs, grouped by completion day. Includes scheduling and dependency delays, not just runner capacity wait. Excludes queued/in-progress jobs and negative/missing durations.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT created_at, started_at, completed_at,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY workflow_job_id
      ORDER BY completed_at DESC, received_at DESC, delivery_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM github_webhooks_silver_dev.actions_workflow_jobs
  WHERE event_type = 'workflow_job' AND action = 'completed' AND status = 'completed'
    AND $__timeFilter(completed_at)
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', completed_at) AS time,
  approx_percentile(date_diff('second', created_at, started_at) / 60.0, 0.5) AS median_minutes,
  approx_percentile(date_diff('second', created_at, started_at) / 60.0, 0.95) AS p95_minutes
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1 AND created_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= created_at
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC
